Cannot apply attributes to other '''Hex Weavers''' or [[Boss]]es. |ability1_cooldown = 7.5 }} ==Description== The '''Hex Weaver''' was a support enemy that appeared in [[Containment]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had decent health, average speed and 50% defense. It also had [[Stun Immunity]]. The '''Hex Weaver''' had one ability, ''Spooky Tricks'', where it threw a green orb on the path that applied attributes to other enemies. The explosion applied [[Bloated]] or [[Nimble]] attributes to enemies. It could not apply attributes to '''Hex Weavers''' or [[Boss]]es. ==Appearance== The '''Hex Weaver''' had black skin. It wore a grey shirt and shoes, blue pants, dark grey armbands with bloody spikes and dark grey shoulder-pads. It also worr a dark grey skull with multiple horns on its head. It held a turquoise orb in its hands, which it used to apply attributes to enemies. ==Strategy== *While not a threat on its own, especially considering how multiple enemies at this stage of the mode are significantly stronger than it, its ability to apply makes it very dangerous. **DPS towers like the [[Engineer]], [[Ranger]] or [[Accelerator]] can be used to kill it. **Stalling towers can be used to slow down enemies that are given the [[Nimble]] attribute. *Defense dropping towers, like the [[Golden Pyromancer]] or [[DJ Booth]] can be used to drop its defense. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} HexWeaverWalk.gif|Walking animation (30 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) HexWeaverThrow.gif|''Spooky Tricks'' animation (30 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) HexWeaverDeath.gif|''Death'' animation (30 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} HexscapeNight3Thumbnail.png|'''Hex Weaver''' on the game thumbnail. HexscapeRegularNight3Thumbnail.png|'''Hex Weaver''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} HexscapeNight3PI.png|'''Hex Weaver''' on a render. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Hex Weaver's''' animations and ability were identical to the [[Fallen Jester]]. ==Update History== *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Hex Weaver''' added. **{{Bug}} Poison and electric defense dropping do not decrease '''Hex Weaver's''' defense. **{{Bug}} '''Hex Weaver''' can completely negate the stalling effects from towers, such as freeze or [[DJ Booth]] slowdown, if during the debuff it applies [[Nimble]] to the enemy. This will make it walk at its regular [[Nimble]] speed while the debuff effects are still on it. *'''6 November 2024''' - [[v1.40.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Poison and electric defense dropping now drops '''Hex Weaver's''' defense, though the [[Jester]] still cannot drop it. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Hex Weaver''' removed. {{Containment|[[Corrupted Titus]] & [[Nightmarish Hulk]]|Wave 20|Hex Weaver|Wave 22|[[Hex's Maw]]|Wave 23}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
